shots.text: We went down the road cut into the wall of the Rift, and at the bottom we went through the Black Gate in single file, the way his armies had come out.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The army filing down the Rift road by lantern light, a thread of small lights against black stone; at the bottom, the Black Gate, a stone door forced open a cart's width.

shots.text: Behind it is the Hollow: a cavern under the world, with a stone sky and grey fire for light. A day's march in, his fortress was waiting for us.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Hollow opening out: a stone sky hung with roots, grey fire in cracks of the ground, and far off, a black fortress with leaning spires and a black sun over its keep.

shots.text: Nhal Vorath. He built it from the ruins of his own city, Vael, which sank with him when he was driven down. Our Dawn Gate hangs in its keep.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Close on the citadel: black stone, roots like veins running out of its walls, Solenne's Dawn Gate hung in the keep, its gold torn half away.

shots.text: You built your city on my city, and you lock my door with my own crown. Come in, then.
shots.speaker: vael_orrun
shots.art_note: The black sun's corona flaring; every colour on screen drains to grey for a moment.

shots.text:
For once we're not holding a road. We're on his.

Dig in. Let his army break on us first.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin, lantern-pole raised, the towers going up in front of the army.
